subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference - HealthSync
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthsync.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo request: Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa,

We just signed up for a trial and I'm interested in a short demo to see how Redwood would fit into our inference pipeline. Quick background: we're HealthSync, a mid-market telehealth platform. Our primary use case is real-time conversation summarization and triage routing for clinician chat (short prompts, lots of concurrent sessions).

Current environment: in-house LLMs on mixed GPU fleet, ~1,200 concurrent sessions at peak, expect 2.5M messages/month by Q4. Latency target is 200-300ms p50 for single-turn generation. We're evaluating options for moving to a managed inference layer for better SLAs and predictable costs.

Can you do a 30-minute demo this week that focuses on latency, routing by region, and cost optimizations (batching/quantization)? Also, would appreciate a short checklist of what model artifacts/inputs we should have ready.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform
HealthSync
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthsync.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-20T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: Demo request: Redwood Inference

Hi Jordan — great to meet you and thanks for signing up! Happy to run a 30-minute demo this week. Two quick qualification questions so we tailor the session: 

1) Which model(s) are you currently running in production (open-source name + any custom fine-tuning)?
2) Typical prompt + response token lengths (avg prompt tokens, avg response tokens)?
3) Is data residency a requirement (do you need US-only or specific region restrictions)?

Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue 7/21 10:00–10:30
- Wed 7/22 14:00–14:30

If neither works, tell me a couple of times that do and we'll accommodate. I'll include a short agenda: intro, perf/latency demo on a comparable workload, routing/fallbacks, and Q&A.

Also looping in Jonas (our solutions AE) to cover pricing and dedicated capacity options.

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Marissa — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below: 

1) Model: running a fine-tuned Llama 2 13B variant (quantized) for summarization.
2) Tokens: avg prompt ~90 tokens, avg response ~120 tokens. Peak concurrent sessions ~1,200 today.
3) Data residency: US-only for PHI-adjacent metadata; actual PHI is handled by downstream services.

Either proposed slot works for us — Wed 7/22 14:00 PDT is best. Attendees: myself + Priya (ops).

Attaching a quick architecture sketch so you can see our current flow.

— Jordan
